# Inkling

> Self-hosted notes app with a built-in MCP server, where people and their AI agents read and edit the same notes. Agents find the sections that answer a question within a token budget (find_context), change one section against the version they read (patch_section), and can leave their edits as suggestions for a person to accept. This site describes Inkling v0.22.1.

The docs pages on this site are rendered from the repository; every page has its Markdown source next to it (docs/NAME.html and docs/NAME.md). The links below point at the Markdown. The MCP server of a running Inkling instance is at https://<its domain>/mcp; each person connects their own client with OAuth 2.1 or an agent connection token. Source code: https://github.com/PROVE1352/inkling

## Connect an agent
- [Tour](tour/index.md): five scenes of an agent working on one note (find_context, patch_section, a conflict and its retry, a suggestion a person decides, an edit lock) with every tool call and answer as text. The page is a walk-through that runs in the browser; it is not connected to a server
- [Demo server](https://demo.inkling.kro.kr): a public Inkling server to try it on. Sign-up takes a user ID, no email address. Limits are tight, accounts and their contents are deleted 14 days after sign-up, and the server may close without notice; keep nothing important there
- [MCP connector and agent guide](docs/MCP.md): connecting Claude Code, claude.ai and other MCP clients, agent connection tokens, tool profiles, every tool, and the order an agent should use them in (find_context, read_page outline and section, patch_section, suggestions, claims, inbox, catch_up, changes_since, get_instructions)
- [Recipes with other MCP servers](docs/RECIPES.md): Inkling as the shared memory next to game engines, design tools and code hosts
- [User guide](docs/GUIDE.md): where each feature is in the web app, including connecting an AI app, reviewing suggestions, reverting agent edits and team agents

## Install and run a server
- [README](https://github.com/PROVE1352/inkling/blob/main/README.md): quick start (`./deploy/local.sh` for a local trial, Docker Compose with Caddy on a server), configuration, limits
- [Deployment](docs/DEPLOY.md): a Linux server step by step, HTTPS, signup keys, mail, sign-in options, semantic search, updates, the local trial
- [Operations](docs/OPERATIONS.md): deployment checklist, upgrades, status summary, database tuning
- [Backups](docs/BACKUP.md): the backup sidecar, retention, encryption, restore
- [Known issues](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md): open problems by area and severity
